content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Quantised convolutional networks can run inference on ARM edge hardware while achieving 97% of full-precision AUPRC and meeting a 5 ms per-window latency budget.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00963","field":"abstract","quote":"quantised convolutional network fits within 200 KB and achieves 97% of its full-precision AUPRC while meeting a 5 ms per-window latency budget on the ARM board"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"ADWIN-based adaptive windowing with rotating ensemble methods can detect concept drift in industrial streams where baselines shift due to seasonal variation and operational changes.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00961","field":"abstract","quote":"Industrial processes evolve over time due to wear, seasonal variation, and deliberate operational changes, causing the statistical properties of sensor streams to shift"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Isolation forest and feature-hashed random forest are deployable on microcontroller-class edge devices with tight RAM budgets, with the latter achieving better AUPRC performance.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00963","field":"abstract","quote":"On the microcontroller, only isolation forest and feature-hashed random forest are deployable; the latter achieves the better AUPRC"}]}]}
